description.zh: 指定证书所属加速域名。需属于HTTPS加速类型。
description.en: The accelerated domain name for the certificate. The domain name must have HTTPS acceleration enabled.

description.zh:
证书内容。该证书必须是通过[CreateDcdnCertificateSigningRequest](~~144478~~)接口创建的CSR对应的签名证书，内部必须是PEM格式的证书。
> 传参前先对证书Base64编码后再使用JavaScript内置函数encodeURIComponent进行编码处理。
description.en:
The content of the signing certificate for the certificate signing request (CSR) that you created by calling the [CreateDcdnCertificateSigningRequest](~~144478~~) operation. The certificate must be in PEM format.

> Base64-encode the certificate content. Then, use the built-in JavaScript function encodeURIComponent to encode the result before you pass the parameter.
